summary.en: Compute, buffers, composition, typed schemas, pack contracts and diagnostics.
summary.zh: 计算、缓冲区、组合执行、类型化 schema、扩展包契约与诊断。

exports.name: GpuContext
exports.signature: export declare class GpuContext

description.en: Shared, lazily created WebGPU device context. Construct through get() or adopt(); the constructor is private.
description.zh: 共享且延迟创建的 WebGPU 设备上下文。通过 get() 或 adopt() 获取；构造函数为私有。

description.en: Get or create the library singleton. A failed creation clears the cache so a later call can retry.
description.zh: 获取或创建库的单例。创建失败会清除缓存，允许之后重试。

description.en: The shared context.
description.zh: 共享上下文。

errors.en: WebGPUUnavailableError / ERR_WGPU_UNAVAILABLE if navigator.gpu is absent or no adapter is returned. Adapter/device request failures may also reject.
errors.zh: 缺少 navigator.gpu 或无法获取适配器时抛出 WebGPUUnavailableError / ERR_WGPU_UNAVAILABLE；适配器或设备请求失败也可能导致拒绝。

description.en: Install an existing device as the shared context before any get() call.
description.zh: 在任何 get() 调用之前，将已有设备设为共享上下文。

description.en: Existing device to use for all kit resources.
description.zh: 所有库资源使用的已有设备。

description.en: Context wrapping the same device; the device is not cloned.
description.zh: 包装同一设备的上下文，不复制设备。

errors.en: Throws WebGPUUnavailableError if the singleton already exists, including a pending get().
errors.zh: 单例已存在（包括尚未完成的 get()）时抛出 WebGPUUnavailableError。

description.en: Clear only the singleton reference; intended for tests/device-recovery integration.
description.zh: 只清除单例引用；用于测试或设备恢复集成。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Does not destroy the old device or migrate existing resources. Do not use to switch a live resource graph.
constraints.zh: 不会销毁旧设备，也不会迁移已有资源；不要用它切换正在使用的资源图。

examples.code:
import { GpuContext } from 'wgpu-kit';
GpuContext.resetForTests(); // isolated test/recovery setup only

description.en: Wait until all previously submitted queue work completes.
description.zh: 等待队列中已提交的工作完成。

description.en: Resolves after device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone().
description.zh: 在 device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone() 完成后兑现。

examples.code:
import { GpuContext } from 'wgpu-kit';
await (await GpuContext.get()).sync();

description.en: Native shared device.
description.zh: 原生共享设备。

description.en: Diagnostic vendor/architecture/description string; adopted device may use "adopted device".
description.zh: 诊断用厂商、架构、描述字符串；接管设备时可能为 "adopted device"。

description.en: Returns device.lost. It resolves with loss information; the declaration comment saying reject is inaccurate.
description.zh: 直接返回 device.lost；设备丢失时兑现并给出信息，声明注释中所写的 reject 不准确。

constraints.en: get() prefers a high-performance adapter, then requests a fallback adapter only if the first result is null. It requests supported storage limits and timestamp-query when available.
constraints.zh: get() 优先请求高性能适配器；只有首次返回 null 才请求回退适配器。它请求受支持的存储限制，并在可用时启用 timestamp-query。

exports.name: Buffer
exports.signature: export declare class Buffer<K extends ScalarKind = ScalarKind>

description.en: Typed storage-buffer wrapper with validated uploads and staged readback.
description.zh: 带上传校验与 staging 读回的类型化存储缓冲区封装。

members.name: create
members.signature: static create<K extends ScalarKind>(kind: K, length: number): Promise<Buffer<K>>

description.en: Allocate length × TYPES[kind].stride bytes on the shared device.
description.zh: 在共享设备上分配 length × TYPES[kind].stride 字节。

description.en: Element kind; selects WGSL type, scalar representation and storage stride.
description.zh: 元素类型，决定 WGSL 类型、标量表示与存储步长。

description.en: Positive integer number of elements, not scalar components or bytes.
description.zh: 正整数元素数量，不是标量分量数或字节数。

description.en: New typed GPU buffer.
description.zh: 新的类型化 GPU 缓冲区。

errors.en: UsageError / ERR_BUFFER_CREATE for an unknown kind or non-positive/non-integer length. GPU allocation can fail due to device limits.
errors.zh: 未知 kind、非正数或非整数 length 会抛出 UsageError / ERR_BUFFER_CREATE；设备限制也可能导致 GPU 分配失败。

description.en: Upload the whole buffer. vec3f input is tightly packed and padded internally to 16-byte storage stride.
description.zh: 上传整个缓冲区。vec3f 输入为紧密排列，内部自动补齐为 16 字节存储步长。

description.en: Matching typed array with exactly length × component-count values. No offset/partial-write overload.
description.zh: 匹配类型的 TypedArray，必须恰好包含 length × 分量数个值；无 offset 或局部写入重载。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

errors.en: UsageError / ERR_BUFFER_WRITE for wrong typed-array constructor or component count. Float contents are not checked for finiteness by Buffer.write.
errors.zh: TypedArray 构造类型或分量数错误时抛出 UsageError / ERR_BUFFER_WRITE；Buffer.write 不检查浮点内容是否有限。

description.en: Copy to a cached staging buffer, map, copy the bytes into a new typed array, unmap; vec3f padding is removed. Concurrent read calls share the in-flight read.
description.zh: 复制到缓存的 staging 缓冲区、映射并复制到新的 TypedArray 后解除映射；去除 vec3f 填充。并发 read 共享进行中的读回。

description.en: CPU-owned tightly packed scalar components.
description.zh: CPU 拥有的紧密排列标量分量。

description.en: Destroy the storage buffer and any staging allocation.
description.zh: 销毁存储缓冲区及已分配的 staging 缓冲区。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Chosen element kind.
description.zh: 选定的元素类型。

description.en: Number of elements.
description.zh: 元素数量。

description.en: Native handle with STORAGE | COPY_SRC | COPY_DST usage only.
description.zh: 原生句柄，仅包含 STORAGE | COPY_SRC | COPY_DST 用途。

description.en: Reachable declaration type; not a root named export. f32/vector floats use Float32Array; signed integer kinds use Int32Array; unsigned kinds use Uint32Array.
description.zh: 签名关联类型，不是根入口具名导出。浮点类型使用 Float32Array，有符号整数使用 Int32Array，无符号整数使用 Uint32Array。

constraints.en: No VERTEX, INDEX, UNIFORM or MAP usage is added. For zero-readback rendering, read gpuBuffer as storage in a native render shader.
constraints.zh: 不会添加 VERTEX、INDEX、UNIFORM 或 MAP 用途。无读回渲染可在原生渲染着色器中将 gpuBuffer 作为 storage 读取。

exports.name: elementKernel
exports.signature: export declare function elementKernel(spec: ElementKernelSpec): ElementKernel;

description.en: Generate and manage a one-invocation-per-element compute kernel. Creation itself is synchronous; GPU preparation is lazy.
description.zh: 生成并管理每元素一次调用的计算内核。创建本身同步；GPU 准备延迟进行。

description.en: Kernel resource declarations, uniforms and WGSL function.
description.zh: 内核资源声明、uniform 与 WGSL 函数。

description.en: Prepared/lazy kernel controller.
description.zh: 可延迟准备的内核控制器。

constraints.en: All declared state/input buffers must be present, have the declared kind, share one device, and have the same element length. Even statically unused declared fields are checked. Extra resource/uniform keys are ignored.
constraints.zh: 所有声明的 state/input 缓冲区必须存在、类型匹配、使用同一设备且元素长度相同；即使静态未使用的声明字段也会校验。额外资源／uniform 键被忽略。

constraints.en: Field names must be unique across state, inputs and uniforms. The uniform name count is reserved and automatically injected. Use valid WGSL identifiers; the compiler checks reserved words.
constraints.zh: 字段名在 state、inputs、uniforms 之间必须唯一。uniform 名 count 为保留名称，由库自动注入。应使用有效 WGSL 标识符，保留字由编译器检查。

constraints.en: Do not read neighboring elements from a buffer being concurrently written in the same dispatch; use separate input/output buffers or PingPong. The library does not provide global synchronization inside a dispatch.
constraints.zh: 不要在同一 dispatch 中读取正在被并行写入的缓冲区邻居元素；应使用分离的输入／输出或 PingPong。库不提供 dispatch 内的全局同步。

constraints.en: The generated source uses lexical resource-use analysis; shadowing a resource name with a local variable is a known analysis limitation.
constraints.zh: 生成源码使用词法资源使用分析；局部变量遮蔽资源名是已知分析限制。

errors.en: Construction: ERR_WORKGROUP_SIZE for an invalid workgroup size; ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING for no arrays; ERR_USAGE for empty code, duplicate names or reserved count uniform.
errors.zh: 构造时：非法工作组大小为 ERR_WORKGROUP_SIZE；无数组为 ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING；空代码、重名或保留 count uniform 为 ERR_USAGE。

errors.en: Preparation/replacement: CompileError / ERR_COMPILE reports WGSL errors with line numbers mapped to user code. Other native WebGPU validation/device failures may occur.
errors.zh: 准备／替换时：CompileError / ERR_COMPILE 报告映射到用户代码行号的 WGSL 错误；也可能发生原生 WebGPU 校验或设备错误。

exports.name: PingPong
exports.signature: export declare class PingPong<K extends string>

description.en: Two same-shaped buffer sets with explicit current/other ownership.
description.zh: 两个形状一致的缓冲区集合，显式区分 current 与 other。

description.en: Allocate both sides with one Buffer per field.
description.zh: 两侧各为每个字段分配一个 Buffer。

description.en: Non-empty field-name to element-kind map.
description.zh: 非空的字段名到元素类型映射。

description.en: Positive integer number of elements, not scalar components or bytes.
description.zh: 正整数元素数量，不是标量分量数或字节数。

description.en: New two-sided buffer group.
description.zh: 新的双侧缓冲区组。

errors.en: Empty kinds throws plain Error("PingPong requires at least one field"); Buffer.create validation applies to each field.
errors.zh: 空 kinds 抛出普通 Error("PingPong requires at least one field")；各字段也适用 Buffer.create 校验。

description.en: Exchange current and other by changing the active side; no GPU copy.
description.zh: 切换活动侧以交换 current 和 other；不复制 GPU 数据。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

members.name: runWith
members.signature: runWith(fn: (write: Record<K, Buffer>, read: Record<K, Buffer>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void>

description.en: Await fn(other,current), then swap only after it resolves successfully.
description.zh: 等待 fn(other,current)；仅成功兑现后交换两侧。

parameters.name: fn
parameters.type: (write: Record<K, Buffer>, read: Record<K, Buffer>) => Promise<void>

description.en: Callback receives write=other and read=current in that order.
description.zh: 回调按顺序接收写侧 other 和读侧 current。

description.en: Callback completion followed by swap.
description.zh: 回调完成后交换。

errors.en: A rejected callback propagates and does not swap sides.
errors.zh: 回调拒绝会向上传播，且不交换两侧。

description.en: Allocate a new group with the same kinds and length; values and active-side index are not copied.
description.zh: 分配具有相同类型和长度的新组；不会复制数据或活动侧索引。

description.en: Fresh same-shaped group.
description.zh: 新的同形组。

description.en: Destroy every field on both sides.
description.zh: 销毁两侧的全部字段。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Current read/render side.
description.zh: 当前读／渲染侧。

description.en: Other write side.
description.zh: 另一写侧。

description.en: Field names in creation order.
description.zh: 按创建顺序排列的字段名。

exports.name: rawKernel
exports.signature: export declare function rawKernel(code: string, entryPoint?: string, label?: string): RawKernel;

description.en: Compile and dispatch complete caller-authored WGSL without generated bindings or bounds checks.
description.zh: 编译并派发调用方完整 WGSL，不生成绑定或越界保护。

description.en: Complete non-empty WGSL module.
description.zh: 完整、非空 WGSL 模块。

description.en: Compute entrypoint name.
description.zh: 计算入口名称。

description.en: Diagnostic shader/kernel label.
description.zh: 诊断用着色器／内核标签。

description.en: Inferred controller type; RawKernel is declared internally but is not a root named export.
description.zh: 可推导的控制器类型；RawKernel 在内部声明，但不是根入口具名导出。

description.en: Idempotently compile using the shared device.
description.zh: 使用共享设备幂等编译。

description.en: Ready for encode.
description.zh: 可编码。

members.name: encode
members.signature: encode(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, entries: GPUBindGroupEntry[], workgroups: number): void

description.en: Create the group-0 bind group and append one compute pass.
description.zh: 创建第 0 绑定组并追加一个计算 pass。

description.en: Caller-owned encoder from the same device; this API records work without submitting it.
description.zh: 来自同一设备的调用方编码器；此 API 只记录工作，不提交。

description.en: Native entries for bind group 0 matching the shader auto layout; resources must come from the shared device.
description.zh: 与着色器自动布局匹配的第 0 绑定组原生条目；资源须来自共享设备。

description.en: Positive integer X workgroup count; Y and Z remain 1. Must fit device dispatch limits.
description.zh: 正整数 X 维工作组数量；Y、Z 为 1，须符合设备 dispatch 限制。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Prepare, encode and submit once.
description.zh: 准备、编码并提交一次。

description.en: Native entries for bind group 0 matching the shader auto layout; resources must come from the shared device.
description.zh: 与着色器自动布局匹配的第 0 绑定组原生条目；资源须来自共享设备。

description.en: Positive integer X workgroup count; Y and Z remain 1. Must fit device dispatch limits.
description.zh: 正整数 X 维工作组数量；Y、Z 为 1，须符合设备 dispatch 限制。

description.en: CPU submission; not a GPU completion fence.
description.zh: CPU 提交完成，不是 GPU 完成栅栏。

description.en: Drop the pipeline reference; native caller resources are not destroyed.
description.zh: 丢弃管线引用，不销毁调用方原生资源。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Uses only bind group 0 and dispatchWorkgroups(workgroups). No library encode-once guard exists; ownership of any mutable uniform/storage parameter buffers is the caller’s responsibility.
constraints.zh: 仅使用第 0 绑定组和 dispatchWorkgroups(workgroups)。没有库级单次编码检查；可变 uniform/storage 参数缓冲区的所有权由调用方负责。

errors.en: ERR_USAGE for empty code, non-positive/non-integer workgroups or encode before prepare; CompileError for WGSL compilation errors. Native binding/pipeline/dispatch validation still applies.
errors.zh: 空代码、非正数／非整数 workgroups、prepare 前 encode 会产生 ERR_USAGE；WGSL 编译错误产生 CompileError；仍须遵守原生绑定／管线／dispatch 校验。

exports.name: defineSchema
exports.signature: export declare function defineSchema<const F extends Record<string, ScalarKind>>(fields: F): Schema<F>;

description.en: Declare field kinds once for TS row inference, WGSL struct generation and per-field buffers.
description.zh: 一次声明字段类型，用于 TS 行类型推导、WGSL 结构体生成及逐字段缓冲区。

description.en: Non-empty field map; insertion order determines generated WGSL member order.
description.zh: 非空字段映射；插入顺序决定生成的 WGSL 成员顺序。

description.en: Schema facade holding the same fields object.
description.zh: 持有同一 fields 对象的 schema 接口。

constraints.en: This is a structure-of-arrays buffer model: buffers() creates one buffer per field, not an interleaved struct array. Do not mutate fields after definition.
constraints.zh: 缓冲区采用 SoA 模型：buffers() 为每个字段创建一个缓冲区，而非交错结构体数组。定义后不要修改 fields。

constraints.en: Field names/kinds are not comprehensively runtime-validated here. Use valid non-reserved WGSL names and avoid helper names raws/destroy in buffers().
constraints.zh: 这里不全面校验字段名／类型；应使用有效、非保留的 WGSL 名称，并避免 buffers() 辅助名称 raws/destroy。

errors.en: UsageError / ERR_USAGE if there are no fields.
errors.zh: 无字段时抛出 UsageError / ERR_USAGE。

description.zh: Buffer 上的类型化行／对象接口；标量使用 number，向量使用分量对象。

description.zh: 创建面向行的封装及底层存储缓冲区。

description.zh: 元素类型，决定 WGSL 类型、标量表示与存储步长。

description.en: Positive integer number of elements, not scalar components or bytes.
description.zh: 正整数元素数量，不是标量分量数或字节数。

errors.zh: 非法行／分量或最终长度不匹配时为 ERR_BUFFER_WRITE。整数类型使用 TypedArray 转换，不另做整数范围校验。

description.en: Read raw components and reconstruct numbers or vector objects.
description.zh: 读回原始分量并重建 number 或向量对象。

description.en: New array of typed rows.
description.zh: 新的类型化行数组。

description.en: Destroy the underlying raw buffer.
description.zh: 销毁底层 raw 缓冲区。

description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Escape hatch for flat typed-array uploads/readback and gpuBuffer access.
description.zh: 用于紧密 TypedArray 上传／读回及 gpuBuffer 访问的底层接口。

description.en: Element kind.

description.en: Number of rows.

errors.en: ERR_USAGE for a struct name failing the identifier regex.
errors.zh: 结构体名称不满足标识符正则时为 ERR_USAGE。

description.zh: 为每个 schema 字段分配 TypedBuffer。

description.en: Positive integer number of rows in every field.
description.zh: 每个字段的正整数行数。

description.en: Field buffers plus raws() and destroy().
description.zh: 字段缓冲区以及 raws()、destroy()。

description.en: Generic field map.
description.zh: 泛型字段映射。

description.en: Original declaration object; declaration order is preserved.

description.en: String(seed), retained from initialization.
description.zh: 初始化时保存的 String(seed)。

description.en: Maximum interaction radius in world units. Use a finite positive number. Also affects grid resolution.
description.zh: 世界单位下的最大交互半径，应使用有限正数，也影响网格分辨率。

description.en: Piecewise force-curve breakpoint at normalized distance d/rMax. Meaningful values are between 0 and 1; not validated by this API.
description.zh: 归一化距离 d/rMax 下的分段力曲线分界点。合理值在 0 与 1 之间；API 不验证。

description.en: Acceleration scale: summed interactions are multiplied by forceFactor*rMax before integration.
description.zh: 加速度缩放；交互总和在积分前乘以 forceFactor*rMax。

description.en: Damping time parameter used as exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). Despite the name, implementation does not include ln(2), so this is an exponential decay time constant rather than a mathematical half-life. Use a positive finite value.
description.zh: 阻尼时间参数，实际公式为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。虽然名称含 HalfLife，实现没有 ln(2)，数学上是指数衰减时间常数，不是真正半衰期。应使用有限正数。

description.en: Base simulation time step per tick, multiplied by the tick argument. The animation callback elapsed time is not measured automatically.
description.zh: 每次 tick 的基础模拟时间步，乘以 tick 参数；不会自动测量动画回调经过的时间。

description.en: Normalized point-quad half-size used by the attached renderer, approximately in clip coordinates after world scaling. It is not a literal pixel size; shader generation rounds the scaled value to four decimals.
description.zh: attach 渲染器使用的归一化点四边形半尺寸，经世界缩放后近似为裁剪空间坐标尺寸。它不是直接像素值；shader 生成时会把缩放后的值保留四位小数。

description.en: Grid-only candidate budget: ceil(maxNeighbors/9) candidates per each of up to 9 neighboring cells (self may count). Use a finite positive number.
description.zh: 仅 grid 使用的候选预算：最多 9 个相邻格子，每格检查 ceil(maxNeighbors/9) 个候选（自身也可能计入）。应使用有限正数。

description.en: Selected literal force name, or 'custom'; updated by setForces().
description.zh: 选中的字面量力名称，或 'custom'；由 setForces() 更新。

description.en: 32-bit hash of the normalized seed string.
description.zh: 归一化种子字符串的 32 位散列。

description.en: Initial exp(-dt/frictionHalfLife); not a live value after setParams or tick multipliers.
description.zh: 初始 exp(-dt/frictionHalfLife)；setParams 或 tick 倍率变化后不会变成实时值。

description.en: Internal supporting type reachable through ParticlesSim["config"]. The property is readonly, not a deeply immutable snapshot.
description.zh: 可通过 ParticlesSim["config"] 取得的内部关联类型。属性 readonly 不等于深层不可变快照。

typeDetails.name: ResolvedConfig (supporting, not exported by this entry point)
typeDetails.type: { count: number; forces: ForceMatrix; forcesName: string; mode: SimMode; color: "species" | "velocity"; bounds: "wrap" | "clamp"; seed: string; seedHash: number; rMax: number; beta: number; forceFactor: number; friction: number; frictionHalfLife: number; dt: number; pointSize: number; maxNeighbors: number }

description.en: All fields are required on resolved output. Do not mutate config directly to control the simulation.
description.zh: 解析结果中所有字段均必有；不要直接修改 config 来控制模拟。

constraints.en: setParams changes a separate internal physics object, so config.rMax/beta/forceFactor/frictionHalfLife/dt/friction may remain initialization values. snapshot() reads the current physics values.
constraints.zh: setParams 修改另一个内部物理对象，因此 config.rMax/beta/forceFactor/frictionHalfLife/dt/friction 可能仍为初始化值。snapshot() 读取当前物理值。

description.en: Configure built-in particle rendering on one canvas.
description.zh: 在一个画布上配置内置粒子渲染。

description.en: Canvas with positive CSS client dimensions, not already acquired by an incompatible drawing backend.
description.zh: 具有有效 CSS 客户区尺寸的画布，不应已被不兼容绘制后端占用。

description.en: Resolves when the canvas renderer is ready.
description.zh: 画布渲染器就绪时完成。

constraints.en: Sets backing width/height to max(1, floor(clientSize*min(devicePixelRatio||1,2))). Configures opaque WebGPU rendering. No automatic resize observer is installed.
constraints.zh: 像素宽高设为 max(1, floor(clientSize*min(devicePixelRatio||1,2)))，配置不透明 WebGPU 渲染。不自动安装 resize observer。

constraints.en: Call once per simulation. A second call replaces the renderer reference without first destroying the previous renderer. attach does not start an animation loop.
constraints.zh: 每个模拟只调用一次。再次调用会替换渲染器引用，但不会先销毁旧渲染器。attach 不启动动画循环。

errors.en: Rejects if canvas.getContext("webgpu") is null or rendering shader/pipeline initialization fails.
errors.zh: canvas.getContext("webgpu") 返回 null 或渲染 shader/管线初始化失败时拒绝。

description.en: Advance one simulation step, optionally render it, and swap current state buffers.
description.zh: 推进一步模拟，按需渲染，并切换当前状态缓冲。

description.en: Multiplier applied to current dt. 0 freezes physical evolution but still submits work/renders/swaps/counts a tick; fractional values slow simulation.
description.zh: 当前 dt 的倍率。0 停止物理推进，但仍提交工作、渲染、交换缓冲并计一次 tick；小数可减慢模拟。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Submits its own command encoder; this high-level API does not expose prepare/encode/endSubmit. Returns before GPU completion. Skip tick entirely to pause GPU work.
constraints.zh: 自行提交 command encoder；此高层 API 不暴露 prepare/encode/endSubmit。返回时 GPU 不一定已完成。若要暂停 GPU 工作，应完全跳过 tick。

constraints.en: Integration uses effectiveDt=dt*dtMultiplier and damping exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). It does not adapt to elapsed animation-frame time.
constraints.zh: 积分使用 effectiveDt=dt*dtMultiplier，阻尼为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。不会根据动画帧实际间隔自动调整。

description.en: Replace the force matrix without recreating the simulation.
description.zh: 无需重建模拟，替换力矩阵。

description.en: Same force selection types as ParticlesConfig.forces. random reuses the original seed, so repeated calls produce the same matrix.
description.zh: 与 ParticlesConfig.forces 相同的力配置类型。random 复用原始种子，因此重复调用得到同一矩阵。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Queues a write to the 16-f32 matrix buffer and updates config.forces/config.forcesName. It does not reset positions or velocities.
constraints.zh: 向 16 个 f32 的矩阵缓冲排队写入，并更新 config.forces/config.forcesName；不重置位置或速度。

errors.en: Unknown force strings throw plain Error. Custom matrix component count/type issues may propagate from Buffer.write; do not pass arbitrary-length arrays.
errors.zh: 未知力名称抛普通 Error。自定义矩阵分量数/类型问题可能从 Buffer.write 传播；不要传任意长度数组。

members.name: setParams
members.signature: setParams(params: { rMax?: number; beta?: number; forceFactor?: number; frictionHalfLife?: number; dt?: number }): void

description.en: Patch current physics parameters; omitted fields retain their current values.
description.zh: 局部更新当前物理参数；省略字段保留当前值。

parameters.name: params
parameters.type: { rMax?: number; beta?: number; forceFactor?: number; frictionHalfLife?: number; dt?: number }

description.en: Partial physics update; all nested fields are optional.
description.zh: 物理参数的部分更新；嵌套字段均可省略。

description.en: Maximum interaction radius in world units. Use a finite positive number. Also affects grid resolution.
description.zh: 世界单位下的最大交互半径，应使用有限正数，也影响网格分辨率。

description.en: Piecewise force-curve breakpoint at normalized distance d/rMax. Meaningful values are between 0 and 1; not validated by this API.
description.zh: 归一化距离 d/rMax 下的分段力曲线分界点。合理值在 0 与 1 之间；API 不验证。

description.en: Acceleration scale: summed interactions are multiplied by forceFactor*rMax before integration.
description.zh: 加速度缩放；交互总和在积分前乘以 forceFactor*rMax。

description.en: Damping time parameter used as exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife). Despite the name, implementation does not include ln(2), so this is an exponential decay time constant rather than a mathematical half-life. Use a positive finite value.
description.zh: 阻尼时间参数，实际公式为 exp(-effectiveDt/frictionHalfLife)。虽然名称含 HalfLife，实现没有 ln(2)，数学上是指数衰减时间常数，不是真正半衰期。应使用有限正数。

description.en: Base simulation time step per tick, multiplied by the tick argument. The animation callback elapsed time is not measured automatically.
description.zh: 每次 tick 的基础模拟时间步，乘以 tick 参数；不会自动测量动画回调经过的时间。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: No runtime numeric validation. Do not explicitly pass undefined for a field, because Object.assign would overwrite it.
constraints.zh: 没有运行时数值验证。不要显式把某字段设为 undefined，因为 Object.assign 会覆盖原值。

constraints.en: If rMax changes grid resolution, an asynchronous rebuild starts; only the latest rebuild wins and old grid resources are replaced. No promise or completion callback is exposed; rebuild errors are not caught here.
constraints.zh: 若 rMax 改变网格分辨率，会启动异步重建；仅最后一次重建生效并替换旧网格资源。不提供 Promise 或完成回调；此处不捕获重建错误。

description.en: Serialize selected current settings, not simulation state.
description.zh: 序列化选定的当前配置，不保存模拟状态。

description.en: JSON containing count, forces name, mode, color, bounds, seed, rMax, beta, forceFactor, frictionHalfLife, dt, pointSize.
description.zh: JSON 字符串，含 count、forces 名称、mode、color、bounds、seed、rMax、beta、forceFactor、frictionHalfLife、dt、pointSize。

constraints.en: Omits particle buffers, maxNeighbors, and the values of custom force matrices. A custom matrix becomes forces:"custom", which particles() cannot resolve as a named matrix; this is not a complete round-trip checkpoint.
constraints.zh: 省略粒子缓冲、maxNeighbors 和自定义力矩阵数值。自定义矩阵变为 forces:"custom"，particles() 无法按名称解析它；此方法不是完整可恢复检查点。

description.en: Read tick-frequency and uncaptured-error counters.
description.zh: 读取 tick 频率和未捕获错误计数。

description.en: fps starts at 0 and updates when accumulated wall time reaches about 500 ms. gpuErrors counts device uncapturederror events observed by this instance.
description.zh: fps 初始为 0，在累计墙钟时间达到约 500 ms 时更新。gpuErrors 统计此实例监听到的设备 uncapturederror 事件。

description.en: Ticks per elapsed wall-clock second, not GPU kernel duration or a benchmark score. Long pauses can affect the next sample.
description.zh: 每墙钟秒的 tick 数，不是 GPU kernel 耗时或性能基准分数。长暂停会影响下一次样本。

description.en: Shared-device uncaptured error count; events may originate from other work using that device.
description.zh: 共享设备的未捕获错误数量；事件可能来自使用同一设备的其他工作。

members.name: debugGrid
members.signature: debugGrid?(): { partial: Buffer; start: Buffer; fill: Buffer; sortedPos: Buffer; sortedSp: Buffer; order: Buffer }

description.en: Expose grid-internal buffers for diagnostics only; undefined outside grid mode.
description.zh: 仅用于诊断，暴露 grid 内部缓冲；非 grid 模式为 undefined。

returns.type: { partial: Buffer; start: Buffer; fill: Buffer; sortedPos: Buffer; sortedSp: Buffer; order: Buffer }

description.en: Borrowed internal buffers, replaced by a later grid rebuild. Do not destroy them.
description.zh: 借用的内部缓冲，后续网格重建会替换它们。不要自行销毁。

description.en: Per-particle per-neighbor-cell partial force contributions.
description.zh: 每粒子、每邻格的部分力贡献。

description.en: Inclusive starting slot for each cell.
description.zh: 各格子的包含式起始槽位。

description.en: Exclusive end slot after scatter, not raw occupancy count.
description.zh: scatter 后排他终止槽位，不是原始格内数量。

description.en: Position copy grouped by cell.
description.zh: 按格子分组的位置副本。

description.en: Species indices grouped by cell.
description.zh: 按格子分组的物种下标。

description.en: Original particle index at each sorted slot.
description.zh: 每个排序槽位对应的原始粒子下标。

members.name: buffers
members.signature: buffers(): { pos: Buffer; vel: Buffer; species: Buffer }

description.en: Get borrowed buffers for the current simulation state.
description.zh: 获取当前模拟状态的借用缓冲。

returns.type: { pos: Buffer; vel: Buffer; species: Buffer }

description.en: pos/vel are count-element vec2f buffers; species is a count-element u32 buffer.
description.zh: pos/vel 为 count 个 vec2f 元素的缓冲，species 为 count 个 u32 元素的缓冲。

description.en: Current 2D world positions.
description.zh: 当前二维世界位置。

description.en: Current 2D velocities.
description.zh: 当前二维速度。

description.en: Species labels 0..3, independent of ping-pong state.
description.zh: 0..3 的物种标签，独立于双缓冲状态。

constraints.en: pos and vel alternate after tick; call buffers() again for the latest side. CPU snapshots require await buffer.read(). The simulation owns these buffers.
constraints.zh: tick 后 pos 和 vel 交替，获取最新侧须再次调用 buffers()。CPU 快照需要 await buffer.read()。这些缓冲由模拟拥有。

caption.en: Obtain the current side after ticking, then read a snapshot.
caption.zh: tick 后取得当前侧，再读取快照。

description.en: Release the simulation-owned particle, matrix, uniform, grid, and renderer resources handled by this implementation.
description.zh: 释放实现中负责清理的粒子、矩阵、uniform、网格和渲染器资源。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Cancel your animation loop and stop using borrowed buffers first. No automatic RAF cancellation, canvas unconfiguration, disposed-state guard, or error-listener removal is provided.
constraints.zh: 先取消动画循环并停止使用借用缓冲。不自动取消 RAF、不取消画布配置、不提供销毁状态防护，也不移除错误监听器。

constraints.en: Avoid destroying while an asynchronous setParams grid rebuild is pending: 2.0.0 does not expose a way to await or cancel that rebuild.
constraints.zh: 避免在 setParams 异步重建网格期间销毁；2.0.0 不提供等待或取消该重建的方式。

typeDetails.name: ForcePresetName (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Literal names accepted as force selections. FORCE_PRESETS itself is not a public root or /particles export.
description.zh: 作为力配置接受的字面量名称。FORCE_PRESETS 本身不是根入口或 /particles 的公共导出。

typeDetails.name: ForceMatrix (supporting, not exported by this entry point)
typeDetails.type: readonly [number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number]

description.en: A flat 4×4 matrix; lookup is mySpecies*4+otherSpecies. Obtain this type without a private-path import using Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string>.
description.zh: 扁平 4×4 矩阵，下标为 mySpecies*4+otherSpecies。无需私有路径导入，可用 Exclude<NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["forces"]>, string> 获取此类型。

typeDetails.name: SimMode (supporting, not exported by this entry point)

description.en: Obtain through NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]>.
description.zh: 可通过 NonNullable<ParticlesConfig["mode"]> 获取。

exports.name: ElementKernel
exports.signature: export interface ElementKernel

description.en: Controller returned by elementKernel.
description.zh: elementKernel 返回的控制器。

description.en: Idempotently resolve the shared context, compile the pipeline and allocate uniforms.
description.zh: 幂等地获取共享上下文、编译管线并分配 uniform。

description.en: Ready for synchronous encode().
description.zh: 可进行同步 encode()。

errors.en: Preparation/replacement: CompileError / ERR_COMPILE reports WGSL errors with line numbers mapped to user code. Other native WebGPU validation/device failures may occur.
errors.zh: 准备／替换时：CompileError / ERR_COMPILE 报告映射到用户代码行号的 WGSL 错误；也可能发生原生 WebGPU 校验或设备错误。

members.name: run
members.signature: run(resources: Record<string, Buffer>, uniforms?: Record<string, UniformValue>): Promise<void>

description.en: Convenience prepare → encode → queue.submit; resets the encode guard after submission.
description.zh: 便捷执行 prepare → encode → queue.submit，并在提交后重置 encode 检查。

description.en: Map every declared state/input field to a matching, equal-length Buffer.
description.zh: 将每个已声明 state/input 字段映射到类型匹配且等长的 Buffer。

description.en: Values for all declared uniforms. Vectors are {x,y,z,w} objects with components required by their kind.
description.zh: 全部已声明 uniform 的值。向量使用 {x,y,z,w} 对象，须包含类型所要求的分量。

description.en: Submission completed on the CPU; does not await completion of GPU work.
description.zh: CPU 侧已提交；不等待 GPU 工作完成。

errors.en: ERR_USAGE before prepare() or for a second encode on this instance before a submission/reset. ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING, ERR_RESOURCE_TYPE or ERR_RESOURCE_LENGTH identify bad resources. ERR_UNIFORM_FIELD/ERR_UNIFORM_UNSUPPORTED come from uniform packing.
errors.zh: 未 prepare() 或同一实例在一次提交／重置前第二次 encode 时为 ERR_USAGE。资源错误对应 ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING、ERR_RESOURCE_TYPE、ERR_RESOURCE_LENGTH。uniform 打包错误对应 ERR_UNIFORM_FIELD／ERR_UNIFORM_UNSUPPORTED。

members.name: encode
members.signature: encode(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, resources: Record<string, Buffer>, uniforms?: Record<string, UniformValue>): void

description.en: Encode a compute pass; uniforms are written immediately with queue.writeBuffer.
description.zh: 编码一个计算 pass；uniform 会立即通过 queue.writeBuffer 写入。

description.en: Caller-owned encoder from the same device; this API records work without submitting it.
description.zh: 来自同一设备的调用方编码器；此 API 只记录工作，不提交。

description.en: Map every declared state/input field to a matching, equal-length Buffer.
description.zh: 将每个已声明 state/input 字段映射到类型匹配且等长的 Buffer。

description.en: Values for all declared uniforms. Vectors are {x,y,z,w} objects with components required by their kind.
description.zh: 全部已声明 uniform 的值。向量使用 {x,y,z,w} 对象，须包含类型所要求的分量。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: One encode per kernel instance per submission. After queue.submit(), call endSubmit(). Use different instances for multiple independently parameterized dispatches in one submission.
constraints.zh: 每个内核实例每次提交只能 encode 一次。queue.submit() 后调用 endSubmit()。同次提交的多组独立参数 dispatch 应使用不同实例。

errors.en: ERR_USAGE before prepare() or for a second encode on this instance before a submission/reset. ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING, ERR_RESOURCE_TYPE or ERR_RESOURCE_LENGTH identify bad resources. ERR_UNIFORM_FIELD/ERR_UNIFORM_UNSUPPORTED come from uniform packing.
errors.zh: 未 prepare() 或同一实例在一次提交／重置前第二次 encode 时为 ERR_USAGE。资源错误对应 ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING、ERR_RESOURCE_TYPE、ERR_RESOURCE_LENGTH。uniform 打包错误对应 ERR_UNIFORM_FIELD／ERR_UNIFORM_UNSUPPORTED。

description.en: Clear the encode-once check after the caller submits its command buffer. Does not submit or wait.
description.zh: 在调用方提交命令缓冲区后清除单次 encode 检查；自身不提交，也不等待。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Permanently disable the guard on this instance; this is not just a one-frame reset.
description.zh: 永久关闭该实例的检查，并非仅重置一帧。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Advanced escape hatch: repeated encodes still share one uniform buffer and can see overwritten values. No corresponding enable method exists.
constraints.zh: 高级底层接口：重复编码仍共享一个 uniform 缓冲区，可能读取被覆盖的值；没有对应重新启用方法。

description.en: Replace only the WGSL function source using the original declarations. Compile failure leaves the old kernel active.
description.zh: 只替换 WGSL 函数源码，保留原声明。编译失败时旧内核继续有效。

description.en: New non-empty WGSL userFn/helper source, with the same resource/uniform contract.
description.zh: 新的非空 WGSL userFn／辅助函数源码，资源和 uniform 契约不变。

description.en: Resolves after successful recompilation; does not dispatch.
description.zh: 成功重新编译后兑现；不进行 dispatch。

errors.en: Construction: ERR_WORKGROUP_SIZE for an invalid workgroup size; ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING for no arrays; ERR_USAGE for empty code, duplicate names or reserved count uniform.
errors.zh: 构造时：非法工作组大小为 ERR_WORKGROUP_SIZE；无数组为 ERR_RESOURCE_MISSING；空代码、重名或保留 count uniform 为 ERR_USAGE。

errors.en: Preparation/replacement: CompileError / ERR_COMPILE reports WGSL errors with line numbers mapped to user code. Other native WebGPU validation/device failures may occur.
errors.zh: 准备／替换时：CompileError / ERR_COMPILE 报告映射到用户代码行号的 WGSL 错误；也可能发生原生 WebGPU 校验或设备错误。

description.en: Release internal uniform storage and cached binding groups; caller-owned resource buffers are not destroyed.
description.zh: 释放内部 uniform 存储与缓存绑定组，不销毁调用方资源缓冲区。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

description.en: Diagnostic name.
description.zh: 诊断名称。

description.en: Complete generated WGSL, including declarations and entrypoint.
description.zh: 完整生成 WGSL，含声明和入口。

description.en: Ordered fields with byte offsets and padded byte size. UniformLayout is reachable but not a root named export.
description.zh: 有序字段、字节偏移与填充后大小。UniformLayout 为关联类型，不是根入口具名导出。

description.en: Chosen X workgroup size.
description.zh: 选定的 X 维工作组大小。

constraints.en: All declared state/input buffers must be present, have the declared kind, share one device, and have the same element length. Even statically unused declared fields are checked. Extra resource/uniform keys are ignored.
constraints.zh: 所有声明的 state/input 缓冲区必须存在、类型匹配、使用同一设备且元素长度相同；即使静态未使用的声明字段也会校验。额外资源／uniform 键被忽略。

constraints.en: Field names must be unique across state, inputs and uniforms. The uniform name count is reserved and automatically injected. Use valid WGSL identifiers; the compiler checks reserved words.
constraints.zh: 字段名在 state、inputs、uniforms 之间必须唯一。uniform 名 count 为保留名称，由库自动注入。应使用有效 WGSL 标识符，保留字由编译器检查。

constraints.en: Do not read neighboring elements from a buffer being concurrently written in the same dispatch; use separate input/output buffers or PingPong. The library does not provide global synchronization inside a dispatch.
constraints.zh: 不要在同一 dispatch 中读取正在被并行写入的缓冲区邻居元素；应使用分离的输入／输出或 PingPong。库不提供 dispatch 内的全局同步。

constraints.en: The generated source uses lexical resource-use analysis; shadowing a resource name with a local variable is a known analysis limitation.
constraints.zh: 生成源码使用词法资源使用分析；局部变量遮蔽资源名是已知分析限制。

exports.name: ElementKernelSpec
exports.signature: export interface ElementKernelSpec

description.en: Complete options accepted by elementKernel.
description.zh: elementKernel 接受的完整配置。

description.en: Diagnostic kernel label.
description.zh: 诊断用内核名称。

description.en: Read-write storage arrays, accessed by their field names in WGSL.
description.zh: 可读写 storage 数组；在 WGSL 中按字段名访问。

description.en: Read-only storage arrays. At least one state or inputs field is required overall.
description.zh: 只读 storage 数组；state 与 inputs 合计至少一个字段。

description.en: Uniform declarations; insertion order must match userFn parameters after the element index.
description.zh: uniform 声明；插入顺序须匹配 userFn 中元素索引之后的参数。

description.en: Integer 1..512 accepted by the library; actual device limits may be stricter.
description.zh: 库接受 1..512 整数；实际设备限制可能更严格。

description.en: Non-empty WGSL containing fn userFn(index:u32, ...uniform arguments). May include helper functions; do not supply the generated bindings/main entrypoint.
description.zh: 非空 WGSL，包含 fn userFn(index:u32, ...uniform 参数)；可含辅助函数，不应重复提供生成的绑定或 main 入口。

constraints.en: All declared state/input buffers must be present, have the declared kind, share one device, and have the same element length. Even statically unused declared fields are checked. Extra resource/uniform keys are ignored.
constraints.zh: 所有声明的 state/input 缓冲区必须存在、类型匹配、使用同一设备且元素长度相同；即使静态未使用的声明字段也会校验。额外资源／uniform 键被忽略。

constraints.en: Field names must be unique across state, inputs and uniforms. The uniform name count is reserved and automatically injected. Use valid WGSL identifiers; the compiler checks reserved words.
constraints.zh: 字段名在 state、inputs、uniforms 之间必须唯一。uniform 名 count 为保留名称，由库自动注入。应使用有效 WGSL 标识符，保留字由编译器检查。

constraints.en: Do not read neighboring elements from a buffer being concurrently written in the same dispatch; use separate input/output buffers or PingPong. The library does not provide global synchronization inside a dispatch.
constraints.zh: 不要在同一 dispatch 中读取正在被并行写入的缓冲区邻居元素；应使用分离的输入／输出或 PingPong。库不提供 dispatch 内的全局同步。

constraints.en: The generated source uses lexical resource-use analysis; shadowing a resource name with a local variable is a known analysis limitation.
constraints.zh: 生成源码使用词法资源使用分析；局部变量遮蔽资源名是已知分析限制。
